grading_instructions: Each eval has 'must_contain' (keywords/phrases the response MUST include) and 'must_not_contain' (keywords/phrases that indicate an error). A response passes if ALL must_contain items are present and NONE of the must_not_contain items are present. Grading is case-insensitive. Use substring matching.

evals.name: fresh-start-eligibility
evals.prompt: My company does cybersecurity consulting and we've been around for 4 years. We want to get on the GSA Schedule so we can sell to federal agencies. I have no idea where to start.
assertions: Runs Step Zero web search for current requirements
Starts at Phase 1 eligibility assessment
Asks about revenue, past performance, accounting system
Identifies SIN 54151S
Defines jargon terms (SIN, eOffer, UEI) on first use with parenthetical
Provides estimated timeline

assertions: Covers SAM.gov registration with UEI
Covers FAS ID with MFA (no longer IdenTrust/ORC certs)

evals.prompt: I'm almost done with my GSA MAS application. I have my technical narratives and pricing done.
